tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: Elative of the Arabic root ك-ر-م (k-r-m), 'to be generous' — 'most generous'. Its root is ك-ر-م (k-r-m). A common Muslim given name. Akram is a Arabic name meaning “Most generous; most noble”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
